rationale: Three-lens review of a 2-file, +38/-1 change (one-token toggle predicate + tests). The core fix is confirmed correct: the edge-case lens returned no findings and verified against source that NewIntegrationPopup is the only disableType={true} caller, the save flow persists the base type + auth_type=oauth marker (tool-pinned base type preserved), the type-select lock is untouched, and New/Edit pages are unchanged; the added toolFieldPlaceholders mock is a legit test-only fix (real store inits it). The blind lens's one 'major' (toggle might rewrite the locked type into an invalid combo) was REFUTED by the edge-case lens — submit uses getOriginalCredentialType so the base type stays pinned. Two items remain, both scope decisions surfaced for the human: (CR-001) acceptance criterion 6 — when OAuth is genuinely unsupported (variant gated out by role/enterprise/feature-flag) the toggle is HIDDEN with no explanatory message; this is pre-existing behavior unchanged by the diff and matches the main integration page (which the user asked to mirror), so it may be out of scope for this bug. (CR-002) the two added tests use credentialType='git' rather than the ticket's Jira/Confluence types and there is no NewIntegrationPopup-level test; the fix is type-agnostic (disabled predicate doesn't depend on type) so 'git' proves the predicate, but adding a Jira case + a popup test would directly cover the named ACs. confidence low because CR-001 is a decision-needed scope question.
